text: The base fee is signature_count x lamports_per_signature, with lamports_per_signature fixed at 5,000. signature_count includes the transaction's Ed25519 signatures plus signatures checked by the Ed25519, Secp256k1 and (when enabled) Secp256r1 precompiles. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-08-12)
keywords: Solana base fee and compute unit price and limit

text: Worked overpay example: a swap that consumed 75,000 CUs but declared 1,400,000 CUs at 50,000 micro-lamports/CU paid a 70,000-lamport priority fee. Oversized limits can also make the scheduler defer a transaction when a hot account nears its per-block write-lock CU cap. The author sells a swap-routing product. (low confidence)
keywords: Solana base fee and compute unit price and limit

text: A transaction pays its fee even when it fails. The fee is deducted from the fee payer before execution, and a transaction that fails while loading accounts can still be committed as fee-only (ProcessedTransaction::FeesOnly in Agave): the payer is debited the full total fee although nothing executes. Firedancer carries the same case as the flag FD_TXN_P_FLAGS_FEES_ONLY. (high confidence)
keywords: Solana base fee and compute unit price and limit

text: Half of the base fee is burned and the other half goes to the block leader. Since SIMD-0096 (status Activated) the leader also receives 100% of the priority fee, so validator reward = base_fee/2 + prioritization_fee. Before SIMD-0096 the priority fee was also split 50/50 burn/leader. (high confidence)
keywords: Solana base fee and compute unit price and limit

text: The scheduler ranks transactions by priority = reward x 1,000,000 / (cost + 1). Reward is the priority fee plus the non-burned half of the base fee. Cost is the scheduler's estimate: signature cost + write-lock cost + instruction-data cost + the requested CU limit (programs execution cost) + loaded-accounts data cost. Agave's own comment says the +1 only avoids division by zero. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-06)
keywords: Solana base fee and compute unit price and limit

text: The runtime deducts the total fee from the fee payer before execution, and the fee stays charged if the transaction fails. A transaction that fails while loading accounts is processed as fee-only (ProcessedTransaction::FeesOnly), and the payer is still debited the full fee. (high confidence)
keywords: Solana base fee and compute unit price and limit
